rules.name: Category spending limit
rules.text: A single claim must not exceed the limit set for its category.

rules.name: No duplicate claims
rules.text: The same employee cannot claim the same vendor, amount and expense date twice.

rules.name: No split billing
rules.text: Claims by the same employee, vendor and category within 2 days must not add up to more than the category limit when each is individually under it.

rules.name: Weekend expenses
rules.text: Weekend expenses are only allowed for Travel and Accommodation.

rules.name: Receipt required
rules.text: A receipt is mandatory for any claim above 500.

rules.name: Submission deadline
rules.text: Claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date.
